channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 23-year-old millionaire cancels San Francisco move over billionaire tax
item.description: Ohio founder Emil Barr fears broader wealth taxes could follow, calling it an anti-entrepreneurial attitude. Jensen Huang disagrees.

item.title: Kroger cuts 3,000 corporate jobs, citing AI efficiency push
item.description: Kroger says the cuts will help fund lower prices, but an analyst notes that savings depend on how the money is used.

item.title: Tina Knowles and Beyonce launch hair care line Cecred
item.description: The line became the most successful debut in history for retailer Ulta Beauty.

item.title: Hailey Bieber sells Rhode to e.l.f. Beauty after addressing acquisition fears with co-founder
item.description: Bieber described the makeup and skincare brand as a personal line of essentials she always keeps in her routine, calling it "my baby, it's our baby."
